I could identify neither Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí nor Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání from a passage that describes him, so those rows stay open. Everything else is unchanged from the last table, except row 8, where I removed a link between two different men that no passage supports.

**Source key:** "Íqán notes" = the notes to the Spanish *Libro de Certeza*; I have translated them.

| # | Name in the Íqán | Who he was | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Mullá Ḥusayn | The first to believe in the Báb, named by Bahá'u'lláh as *"the recipient of the effulgent glory of the Sun of divine Revelation."* ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585)) 'Abdu'l-Bahá lists Mullá Ḥusayn of Bushrúyih first among the Báb's disciples who spread through Persia. He led the company that built the fort near Shaykh Ṭabarsí's tomb and fell there ([A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_15&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.282)). | Íqán ([The Kitáb-i-Íqán](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-iqan_bahaullah/?paraId=para_260&selectionString=kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.0~kitab-i-iqan-prod-version_en_a0.585)); *A Traveller's Narrative* ([A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_15&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.282)) |
| 2 | Siyyid Yaḥyá (Vaḥíd) | Siyyid Yaḥyáy-i-Dárábí, surnamed Vaḥíd. The Sháh sent him to investigate the Báb, and he was *"one of the most erudite, eloquent and influential of his subjects — a man who had committed to memory no less than thirty thousand traditions."* | Shoghi Effendi, *God Passes By* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_41&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3w.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3w.1628)) |
| 3 | Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání | Surnamed Ḥujjat: *"An Aḵhbárí, a vehement controversialist, of a bold and independent temper of mind, impatient of restraint, a man who had dared condemn the whole ecclesiastical hierarchy from the Abváb-i-Arba‘ih down to the humblest mullá, he had more than once, through his superior talents and fervid eloquence, publicly confounded his orthodox S̱hí‘ah adversaries."*, and *"even fiercer in zeal than Vaḥíd, and almost as eminent in rank."* | Shoghi Effendi, *God Passes By* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_42&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.897)) |
| 4 | Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Basṭámí | A Letter of the Living, *"the first to leave the House of God (Shíráz) and the first to suffer for His sake."* ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_39&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.1230)) He proclaimed the Báb before Shaykh Muḥammad-Ḥasan in Najaf, was declared a heretic, tried, taken to Istanbul and condemned to hard labour ([The Kitáb-i-Aqdas](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-aqdas_bahaullah)). | Shoghi Effendi ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_39&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.1230)); Nabíl, as summarised in the Aqdas notes ([The Kitáb-i-Aqdas](https://oceanlibrary.com/kitab-i-aqdas_bahaullah)) |
| 5 | Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí | **Not identified in the library.** I searched *"Mullá Sa'íd-i-Bárfurúshí"*, "Mulla Said Barfurushi", "Sa'ídu'l-'Ulamá Bárfurúsh", Mullá Sa'íd Bárfurúsh Bábí… Ṭabarsí and the Persian ملا سعید بارفروشی, and no passage describes a Bábí of this name. The Íqán's notes have no entry for him ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)). The nearby hits are other men. Shaykh Sa‘íd-i-Hindí was a Letter of the Living sent to India ([Messages to the Indian Subcontinent](https://oceanlibrary.com/messages-to-the-indian-subcontinent_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_23&selectionString=messages_to_the_indian_subcontinent_en-bl3d.0~messages_to_the_indian_subcontinent_en-bl3d.281); [The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1791&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_1gg.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_1gg.1531)). The *Sa‘ídu'l-‘Ulamá*, the mujtahid of Bárfurúsh, was the Báb's enemy ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_933&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_sm.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_sm.1633); [A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_15&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.282)). Quddús was martyred in Bárfurúsh ([Memorials of the Faithful](https://oceanlibrary.com/memorials-of-the-faithful_abdul-baha/?paraId=fn_126)). Nothing shows that any of these is the man in the Íqán. | — |
| 6 | Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání | A Bábí believer martyred at Shaykh Ṭabarsí (my translation of the note). ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) Nabíl's list of the Ṭabarsí martyrs has a *"Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Bárfurúshí"*, with no description beside the name ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1316&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_139.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_139.31)). Shoghi Effendi's Persian list in *The Dawn-Breakers* has *"Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Bárfurúshí"* at number 164 ([TAF 10](https://oceanoflights.org/file/Shoghi-Effendi-TAF-10_fa.docx)). He may be the same man as the Íqán's "Mázindarání", since Bárfurúsh is in Mázindarán, but no passage says so. | Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)); Nabíl's list ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1316&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_139.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_139.31); [TAF 10](https://oceanoflights.org/file/Shoghi-Effendi-TAF-10_fa.docx)) |
| 7 | Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí | A Letter of the Living, **"noted for his learning, his enthusiasm and eloquence"* ([shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers_en](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=149.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Y%C3%BAs%C3%BAf%2Di%2DArdib%C3%ADl%C3%AD%2C%20one,the%20battle%20of%20Vas%2DKas))*, who struck terror into his adversaries in Kirmán. | Nabíl, *The Dawn-Breakers* ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)) |
| 8 | Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khú'í | A close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and tutor to the children of His household, martyred at Ṭabarsí (my translation of the note). ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) Nabíl also lists *"Mullá Maḥmúd-i-Khú'í, brother of Mullá Mihdí, one of the Letters of the Living and a distinguished divine"* ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)). The passage does not say which Mullá Mihdí is meant, so I do not link him to this row. | Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
| 9 | Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí | The mujtahid of Turshíz in Khurásán, **"highly esteemed for his piety and rectitude of conduct"**, who studied for years in Najaf, was sent by fellow-mujtahids to propagate their teachings, and was taken to the block. | Nabíl, *The Dawn-Breakers* ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)) |
| 10 | Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí | *"A close companion of Bahá'u'lláh, and a tutor to the children of His household."* He and his brother Mullá Báqir-i-Kandí were in the fort at Ṭabarsí, and a messenger from Kand tried to persuade them to escape. | Nabíl ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)) |
| 11 | Mullá Báqir | The brother of Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí, martyred at Ṭabarsí (my translation of the note). ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) Nabíl names *"Mullá Mihdí and his brother Mullá Báqir-i-Kandí"* together in the fort ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)). He is not Mullá Báqir-i-Tabrízí, a Letter of the Living ([Revelation](https://oceanlibrary.com/kjv-apocalypse-saint-john-of-patmos)). | Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)); Nabíl ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanlibrary.com/dawn-breakers_nabil/?paraId=para_1404&selectionString=dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.0~dawn-breakers-prod-version_en_15p.75)) |
| 12 | Mullá ‘Abdu'l-Khálíq-i-Yazdí | First a Jewish priest, then a convert to Islám and the Shaykhí school, and converted to the Bábí Faith by Mullá Ḥusayn (my translation of the note). | Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
| 13 | Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání | An uncle of Ṭáhirih and one of the most learned and famous Shaykhís. After becoming a Bábí he was one of the most active and capable Bábí expositors in Tihrán (my translation of the note). | Íqán notes ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |

Bahá'u'lláh then adds *"and others, well nigh four hundred in number, whose names are all inscribed upon the 'Guarded Tablet' of God."* ([Kutob 03 1 2 (notes)](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf))

The one open question is row 5. Nabíl's martyr list gives only a bare name for the Ni‘matu'lláh of row 6, and none of the sources I searched names a Mullá Sa‘íd of Bárfurúsh among the Bábí believers.
